{{Quote|'James Bond meets Star Wars' is a shorthand way of describing the series but it will be more than that. Cross is not Bond but the stories will be influenced by Bond, as well as Secret Agent, Jason Bourne, and so on.|John Ostrander|<ref name="JCF" />}}
'''''Star Wars: Agent of the Empire''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series from [[Dark Horse Comics]] written by [[John Ostrander]]. Set between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the miniseries follows the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Jahan Cross]] and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[IN-GA 44]] whose undercover assignments for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] take them across the galaxy to exotic locales, filled with danger and intrigue. The first issue was published on [[December 14]], [[2011]] and the final issue was published on [[February 27]], [[2013]]. In April 2013, it was revealed that there were no further issues planned for the series.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.forcecast.net/story/home/Jedi_Journals_April_2013_150949.asp|text=Jedi Journals: April 2013|date=2013-04-03|work=[[The ForceCast]]|archivedate=20210518110911}}</ref> On [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]], [[Cavan Scott]] expressed interest in writing a continuation of the series if the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity was still active.<ref>{{Twitter|username=cavanscott|url=status/1552311007610933254|name=[[Cavan Scott]]|quote=Off the top of my head, the Bane Trilogy, Republic (my all time favourite SW comic to this day), Dark Empire, Tales of the Jedi. Also, a special mention to Agent of the Empire which, if we were still writing the EU, I would LOVE to continue.|nolive=1}}</ref>
